prompt: A wide-angle view of a messy artist's studio. In the center stands a wooden easel holding a blank canvas. Next to it, a small wooden stool has a paint-splattered palette and several paintbrushes resting on it. A half-full jar of water sits on the floor beside the stool, along with a crumpled tube of paint and a dirty rag. In one corner, a bookshelf is filled with old art books and a sketchbook is open on one shelf. A single pencil lies next to the sketchbook. On top of the bookshelf, there's a classical sculpture bust and a simple vase. A large piece of draped cloth hangs over a chair in the background. A large color wheel chart is pinned to the exposed brick wall. A vintage lamp on a small table provides warm light, and an old-fashioned analog clock hangs on the wall, but there's no digital television or modern computer in sight. The room has a large window looking out, but there are no potted plants on the windowsill. The floor is made of worn wooden planks. This is a space for traditional art, so you won't find any high-tech gadgets like a camera or a telephone, nor is there a pet cat napping anywhere.
